State.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Or
% 19.05.2023 Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.

1.  This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.106/2019 registered at PS Mansarovar Park under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on grounds of settlement between the parties dated 10th March,
2021 arrived at with the facilitation of the Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts.
The said settlement is on record of this Court.
The petitioner Nos.1-4 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court and duly identified by the counsels and the IO.
As per the settlement, the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 have agreed to resume their matrimonial life with effect from 18th March, 2021 and are living harmoniously with each other.
Both parties state that they are complying with the terms of the settlement.
The This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 17:56:56 respondent No.2/complainant has no object objection to the quashing of the FIR.
Affidavits in this respect are also on record.

2. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.106/2019 registered at PS Mansarovar Park under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
